text:
mira: Quick follow-up from the RFC 3 we need a concise playbook for rolling out lossy quant (FP8/INT8/4bit) gradually. Goal: predictable QPS impact, fast rollback, and minimal customer-visible regressions.

alex: +1. can we define a single small canary config that ops can flip? Also want a clear metric set.

sam: For metrics: latency p50/p95, token cost delta, and a quality regression signal (narrow eval set + production sampling). Degscore alone isn't enough.

mira: Agreed. Proposal: three-phase rollout 3 shadow, small canary (1% traffic), ramp (10->50%) with automatic rollback thresholds. Keep dedicated customer opt-outs.

nidhi: For the shadow phase, we should run the quantized path in parallel and compute candidate outputs for offline scoring. No customer traffic served from quant until canary pass.

alex: Ops needs a minimal config snippet for the canary. Something like:
```
canary:
  variant: "fp8-lite"
  shard_pct: 1
  sampling_rate: 0.1
  compare_eval_set: "quick-qa-100"
```

sam: + include `rollout_guard` thresholds: quality_drop_pct, latency_increase_ms, token_cost_delta_pct. If any trigger, immediate rollback to last safe profile.

mira: How do we detect subtle quality regressions? We have small eval sets but they miss long-tail. Suggest: combined signal = eval_rejects + increase in human escalation rate + automatic BLEU-like metric on sampled completions.

nidhi: Also add model output fingerprint checks for hallucination patterns. If hallucination rate spikes > X, roll back.

alex: API/interface question: should precision profiles be part of the model manifest or ops routing policy? My vote: runtime profile references in manifest, but control via routing/rollout system so ops can flip without new model uploads.

mira: Yes 3 split ownership: ML owns profiles (metadata + calibration tests), Ops owns rollout config (traffic %, canary rules). Customer side can override at endpoint level.

sam: Need a migration path: older runtimes may not understand `fp8-lite`. Add `compatibility_version` in profile and a server-side mapping table. If unsupported, route to safe fallback.

nidhi: Telemetry: tag every token with profile_id and quality_signal snapshot id. Keep retention for 30d for quick bisect.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary `fp8-lite` started in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-21T12:03:12Z (shard 1%).

alex: Nice 3 after 24h we should run a small A/B compare job and produce a short summary. Whoever runs it, paste results here.

mira: I'll own the A/B script. Plan to capture: ngrams divergence, perplexity delta on eval, p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens. Anything else?

sam: Include example-based human review queue for 50 flagged items (random + high delta ones). That helps catch semantic regressions.

nidhi: One more: add a required checklist before canary: calibration curve, per-layer outlier check, KV-cache compatibility smoke test. Ops should block rollout if any fail.

mira: Great. I'll turn this into a short playbook doc and a yaml template. Thx all, will ping when draft is ready. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks 3 this is actionable.

sam: 👍

nidhi: :rocket:
